name: Elven Relations
source:
Takuya is a swordsman in the Royal Army of the Kingdom of Reachfar, who is sent on a unique mission into the Endless Forest to establish diplomatic relations with the elven people. Could there be love awaiting him in the depths of the Elvenglade?

[From [url=http://www.toothycat.net/~hologram/ElvenRelations/]The Official site[/url]]
